A half-day is computed as  $ \frac{3}{2} $ hours - one-half a regular 7 hour workday.

4. The official vacation period is June 1 - September 15 of each year.

With the supervisor's approval and depending on office work load, an employee may schedule vacation time before June 1, but may schedule no more vacation than has been earned up to that point.
